description: Structural validation of envelopes (spec 02 section 9). Validate `envelope`; the result MUST match `expected.valid`, and on failure the reported code MUST equal `expected.error`. Signature verification is NOT part of this check except where the vector's error code says so.

vectors.name: valid-effect
vectors.description: a well-formed effect envelope

vectors.name: valid-cognition
vectors.description: the minimal cognition envelope

vectors.name: valid-aggregate
vectors.description: a read-class aggregation record

vectors.name: valid-signal
vectors.description: an inbound signal record

vectors.name: valid-correlation-ref-url-shaped
vectors.description: a URL-shaped correlation-ref is VALID and MUST be stored verbatim without being parsed, resolved or dereferenced (spec 02 section 10)

vectors.name: correlation-ref-too-long
vectors.description: 513 octets exceeds the 512-octet limit

vectors.name: cognition-with-evidence
vectors.description: a cognition envelope MUST NOT be able to carry content of any kind

vectors.name: cognition-with-execution
vectors.description: cognition is not an effect

vectors.name: signal-with-mandate-ref
vectors.description: a signal carries no authority, so it has no field in which to carry a mandate

vectors.name: aggregate-class-not-read
vectors.description: only class read may be aggregated

vectors.name: aggregate-count-mismatch
vectors.description: total must equal the sum of by-action

vectors.name: aggregate-too-many-samples
vectors.description: at most 16 samples

vectors.name: unknown-top-level-member
vectors.description: an unknown member is rejected -- and note precisely which member this vector adds: there is no boolean anywhere that could mean approved

vectors.name: unknown-member-in-execution
vectors.description: unknown members are rejected inside sub-objects too

vectors.name: effect-missing-execution
vectors.description: effect requires execution

vectors.name: effect-missing-mandate-ref
vectors.description: no effect without a mandate reference -- this is maxim 8 as a schema rule

vectors.name: unknown-kind
vectors.description: unknown envelope kinds are rejected, never stored as opaque

vectors.name: unsupported-version
vectors.description: a 0.1 implementation MUST NOT guess at another version

vectors.name: unknown-classification
vectors.description: the taxonomy is closed: read | benign | consequential | prohibited

vectors.name: genesis-prev-not-null
vectors.description: seq 0 MUST have prev-hash null

vectors.name: non-genesis-prev-null
vectors.description: seq > 0 MUST carry a predecessor hash

vectors.name: identity-key-sig-mismatch
vectors.description: the envelope must be signed by the subject it names

vectors.name: execution-time-inverted
vectors.description: finished-at MUST NOT precede started-at

vectors.name: bad-timestamp-offset
vectors.description: only UTC with a Z suffix and exactly three fractional digits

vectors.name: bad-timestamp-precision
vectors.description: exactly three fractional digits are required

vectors.name: uppercase-hex-hash
vectors.description: hex is lowercase everywhere

vectors.name: short-hex-hash
vectors.description: a SHA-256 digest is exactly 64 hex characters

vectors.name: non-integer-seq
vectors.description: protocol objects carry integers only

vectors.name: integer-out-of-range
vectors.description: protocol integers are bounded by binary64 exactness

vectors.name: evidence-missing-payload-hash
vectors.description: evidence exists to bind a payload hash

vectors.name: evidence-with-inline-payload
vectors.description: there is no member in which a payload could live inside a signed envelope -- this is what makes chain integrity independent of payload presence (spec 04 section 5)

vectors.name: unknown-outcome
vectors.description: the outcome set is closed: applied | failed | denied | blocked | attempted
